title: Production Data Entry & Analysis
description:
**Company:** Rama Overseas Ltd.  
**Job Location:** Leather Complex, Bantala, Kolkata  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Experience:** As per skill proficiency

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical candidate to manage production-related data entry, maintain accurate records, and analyse production data to support efficient manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Enter, update, and maintain daily production data accurately.
* Collect and compile production-related information from different departments.
* Analyse production data to identify discrepancies and areas for improvement.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
* Maintain records of production output, productivity, material consumption and other relevant parameters.
* Work extensively with MS Excel and other data management tools.
* Coordinate with the production team to obtain and validate data.

Required Skills

* Strong data entry skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and data analysis.
* Ability to organise, interpret, and present production data effectively.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Educational Qualification

Any graduate or candidate with a relevant educational background and strong data entry and analytical skills may apply.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
